decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 5 - Before the ventaltion duct is used on the premises, it shall be enclosed with sound-insulating material and mounted in a way which will minimise transmission of structure borne sound in accordance with a scheme to be approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - The scheme approved shall be fully implemented before the (A3 restaurant) opens to customers.
Condition : 7 - The use hereby permitted for A3 caf?/restaurant use purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times: Monday to Saturday, 7.30am to 11.00pm.

Condition : 8 - The A3 caf?/restaurant use shall not commence until the back door to the premises has been fitted with a self-closure and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with a self-closing door.
description: Change of use from A1 coffee shop to cafe/restaurant use, including the addition of ducting pipe to premises
